page.overview:
Who is Horseman?

Horseman is a Gifter in the Beasts Pirates and an attendant of Bao Huang.

Horseman is an average-sized man with tanned skin and a visible abdominal muscle. Due to his SMILE ability, his head is that of a white horse with a gray mane. On his head, he wears a metal helmet with a yellow crest. He also wears a black leather vest, a fur coat, dark green pants, light brown gloves, and dark brown boots.

Horseman is a levelheaded and perceptive individual, keeping a close eye on his surroundings and warning Bao Huang when the Shinuchi is being careless.

Horseman is a very fast runner, rivaling even Gazelleman, and is sometimes used to quickly deliver messages.
